title: The Last Postcards
author: Sable Reyes
blurb: Beatrix Dravenmoor, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
